# Copilot Instructions

## Project shape

- This is a minimal static HTML project: the pages are standalone files in the repository root, with no shared application runtime or assets.
- `Rishabhh` contains a small HTML page. `experimen1.html` is an unfinished document with no page body; do not assume or invent its intended content.

## Build, test, and lint

- There is no dependency manifest or configured build, test, or lint command. No automated or single-test command is available.
- To check a page change, open the affected HTML file in a browser.

## Markup conventions

- The repository has no established framework or shared component conventions. Keep changes in plain HTML unless a request calls for additional tooling or assets.
- Existing markup is inconsistent, so do not copy malformed syntax as a convention; use valid HTML5 document structure when editing a page.
